_comment: Generated by write_webhook_vectors_v2 (cargo test -p bankapi --test webhook_vectors -- --ignored write_webhook_vectors_v2) from the composed catalogue's projections, envelope v2 and the signer. Do not edit by hand. msg_id is the delivery id to connector 01a0a592-0000-7000-8000-0000000000c1. A case with must_ignore: true verifies, and a payment receiver records no payment for it.

vectors.name: quota.exceeded
vectors.note: period_* are calendar dates (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh); the end is exclusive.

vectors.name: flow.output

vectors.name: unknown.future_event
vectors.note: A type this SDK does not know yet: verify it and parse it as an unknown envelope, never throw. Its data also has &, < and > literally (the envelope is encoded with HTML escaping off): sign and verify over these exact bytes, not an HTML-escaped copy.
